name: Groups
summary: Company-scoped groups of users that grant project roles to all their members at once.

roles.note: No group-specific permission strings exist in the seed catalog. Visibility and deletion depend on super-admin status or being the group's creator or member.

actions.note: Others see only groups they belong to

nfr.statement: Largest group (members × projects) that create, update and delete must handle.
nfr.open_question: Grants are written in chunks of 100 (T3D-RULE-104). What group sizes must stay responsive?

requirements.title: Group names are unique per company, and the creator is a member
requirements.statement: Every group belongs to a company and needs a name that, after trimming, no other active group in that company uses. The creator is always added as a member.
open_checks: User counts refresh outside the create transaction and may read uncommitted data

acceptance_criteria.given: Company C has an active group named Field team
acceptance_criteria.when: A user creates a group named "Field team " in C
acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected as a duplicate

acceptance_criteria.given: A user creates a group without listing themselves

requirements.title: Group grants are separate from direct roles
requirements.statement: Grants given through a group are stored separately from a user's direct project role. Removing a user from a group, or a project from a group, removes only that group's contribution. Access through a direct role or another group stays.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with a direct viewer role on P who is also in group G granting collaborator on P
acceptance_criteria.then: They are still a viewer on P

requirements.title: Updating a group replaces its member and project lists
requirements.statement: A group update sends the complete lists of members and projects. Anything left out is removed, so an update that omits the project list removes every project from the group.
open_checks: No single transaction covers the update
Bulk assignment keeps the last role when the same group and project appear twice

acceptance_criteria.given: Group G has members A and B and projects P and Q
acceptance_criteria.when: G is updated with members [A] and projects [P]
acceptance_criteria.then: B loses G's access to both projects, and A loses G's access to Q

requirements.title: Super-admins see every group; others see their own
requirements.statement: A company super-admin sees all active groups in the company. Everyone else sees only groups they are a member of. Support users are left out of group member lists unless support mode is on.

acceptance_criteria.given: Company C has groups G1 and G2, and user U is a member of G1 only
acceptance_criteria.when: U and a company super-admin each list groups
acceptance_criteria.then: U sees G1, and the super-admin sees G1 and G2

requirements.title: Bulk group deletion can partly succeed
requirements.statement: Each group in a bulk delete can be deleted by a company super-admin or by its creator. Allowed groups are deleted and their grants removed. The response lists deleted, unauthorised and not-found groups separately; it fails only if none could be deleted.

acceptance_criteria.given: A non-admin user who created G1 but not G2
acceptance_criteria.then: G1 is deleted, G2 is reported as unauthorised, and the request succeeds
